problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 65 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 41 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 45 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 69 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 31 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 60 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 55 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 44 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
